settings.review_text: This hoodie hits different. The fabric is thick, the fit is perfect, and the colorway goes with everything. Stopped a room when I walked in.
I've spent $300 on hoodies from bigger brands and this beats every one of them. NCD doesn't play around with quality.
Saw it on TikTok, copped it same day. Arrived in 2 days and the packaging alone felt premium. Wearing it everywhere.
Been wearing NCD for 6 months now. Every piece holds up and the fits are fire. Not just hype — the quality is real.
